The 2025–26 Ukrainian Premier League season, referred to as the VBET Ukrainian Premier League for sponsorship reasons, was the 35th top-level football club competition since the fall of the Soviet Union and the 18th since the establishment of the Ukrainian Premier League (UPL).

The season started on 1 August 2025 and ended on 24 May 2026. The UPL clubs decided not to hold the season opening match Ukrainian Super Cup due to the ongoing Russian military aggression against Ukraine.[2][3]

Dynamo Kyiv were the defending champions, having won their 17th Premier-Liha title and their 30th overall domestic title in the previous season.

Teams

[edit]

This season, the Ukrainian Premier League remained at 16 teams.

Promoted teams

[edit]
  • Epitsentr Kamianets-Podilskyi – first-placed team of the 2024–25 Ukrainian First League (debut)
  • SC Poltava – second-placed team of the 2024–25 Ukrainian First League (debut)
  • Metalist 1925 Kharkiv – third-placed team of the 2024–25 Ukrainian First League, winner in relegation play-off (returning after one-year absence)
  • FC Kudrivka – fourth-placed team of the 2024–25 Ukrainian First League, winner in relegation play-off (debut)

Relegated teams

[edit]
  • Inhulets Petrove – relegated after one season in the top flight
  • Chornomorets Odesa – relegated after three seasons in the top flight
  • Vorskla Poltava – relegated after twenty-nine seasons in the top flight, lost in relegation play-off
  • Livyi Bereh Kyiv – relegated after one season in the top flight, lost in relegation play-off

The decision on this match should have been made by the UAF Control and Disciplinary Committee. However, on February 20, 2026, Veres announced that it had agreed to have match postponed, rescheduled and later resumed and played on the club's stadium in Rivne in the spring 2026. All goals were scored in the match at the Avangard Stadium in Rivne.[25][26][27][28][29][30][31]

The decision on this match will be made by the UAF Control and Disciplinary Committee later.[32][33].On March 5, 2026, the Ukrainian Football Federation (UAF) Control and Disciplinary Committee awarded FC Obolon a technical victory.[34] The UPL has not been rushing to update the competition table regarding the decision, and at the end of April, it considers the match as one that has not been played. Oleksandria's appeal against the UAF Control and Disciplinary Committee's decision was dismissed.[35]
  4. ↑ Due to the rescheduling of the match between SC Poltava and Dynamo Kyiv to the Valeriy Lobanovskyi Dynamo Stadium, Zorya's match was shifted by two days – from May 16 to May 18.

Relegation play-offs

[edit]

Teams that placed 13th and 14th in the 2025–26 Ukrainian Premier League play a two-leg play-off with the third and fourth teams of the 2025–26 Ukrainian First League.

The withdrawn 14th-placed Rukh Lviv[b] was replaced with the 15th-placed FC Oleksandriya.

This round includes 2 clubs from the Premier League: FC Oleksandriya and Kudrivka; 2 clubs from the First League: Livyi Bereh Kyiv and Ahrobiznes Volochysk.

Kudrivka 2–2 (3–2 p) Ahrobiznes Volochysk 0–0 2–2
